title: Tomorrow Stories #1 Alan Moore America's Best Comics 1999 Greyshirt Cobweb
condition_description: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Alan Moore's Tomorrow Stories #1 (October 1999), America's Best Comics / Wildstorm. First appearances of Jack B. Quick (Kevin Nowlan), The Cobweb (Melinda Gebbie), The First American and U.S. Angel (Jim Baikie) and Greyshirt (Rick Veitch). Painted Greyshirt cover. $3.50 cover price.

Back cover: NextPlanetOver.com ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
